cards.example_en: This book costs one pound.
cards.example_zh: 这本书一英镑。

cards.example_en: Mum asked me to pour tea for our guests.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈让我给客人倒茶。

cards.example_en: The power failed, so we finished homework by candlelight.
cards.example_zh: 电力中断了，我们只好点着蜡烛把作业写完。

cards.example_en: Morning practice on the piano wakes the whole flat.
cards.example_zh: 早上的钢琴练习会把整套房的人吵醒。

cards.example_en: The teacher will praise her clear speech.
cards.example_zh: 老师会表扬她清晰的发言。

cards.example_en: Most students prefer group work.
cards.example_zh: 大多数学生更喜欢小组作业。

cards.example_en: Please prepare your books before class.
cards.example_zh: 上课前请准备好你的书。

cards.example_en: Each group will present its survey results on Monday.
cards.example_zh: 每个小组将在星期一展示调查结果。

cards.example_en: The president visited our city during the holiday.
cards.example_zh: 假期里，总统来到了我们这座城市。

cards.example_en: Cameras from the press lined the street after the final.
cards.example_zh: 决赛结束后，新闻界的摄像机排在街道两旁。

cards.example_en: Students are under a lot of pressure before exams.
cards.example_zh: 考试前学生承受着很大的压力。

cards.example_en: The maths quiz was pretty easy.
cards.example_zh: 这次数学小测相当容易。

cards.example_en: The corner shop raised the price of milk again.
cards.example_zh: 街角小店又把牛奶的价格提高了。

cards.example_en: He felt pride when the team won.
cards.example_zh: 队伍获胜时他感到自豪。

cards.example_en: Children start primary school around the age of six.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们大约六岁开始上小学。

cards.example_en: The prince travelled to a far country.
cards.example_zh: 王子前往一个遥远的国家。

cards.example_en: The princess walked through the garden.
cards.example_zh: 公主穿过花园。

cards.example_en: The office can print your timetable before the first lesson.
cards.example_zh: 办公室可以在第一节课之前打印你的课程表。

cards.example_en: The private garden behind the house is locked at night.
cards.example_zh: 屋后的私人花园晚上会锁上。

cards.example_en: First prize was a new bicycle from the shop.
cards.example_zh: 一等奖的奖品是商店里的一辆新自行车。

cards.example_en: It will probably rain.
cards.example_zh: 大概会下雨。

cards.example_en: My deskmate feels that this problem has a simpler solution.
cards.example_zh: 我的同事觉得这个问题有一个更简单的解决方案。

cards.example_en: Our school garden can produce enough tomatoes for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 学校菜园能生产出够午饭吃的西红柿。

cards.example_en: This soap is a product of the village workshop.
cards.example_zh: 这种肥皂是村里作坊的产物。

cards.example_en: Our class performs in the afternoon programme on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 我们班参加周五下午的那场节目演出。

cards.example_en: Maths no longer scares her because of steady progress.
cards.example_zh: 因为进步稳定，数学不再让她害怕。

cards.example_en: The garden project needs soil, seeds, and water.
cards.example_zh: 这个花园计划需要泥土、种子和水。

cards.example_en: I promise to return your ruler after maths class.
cards.example_zh: 我承诺数学课后把尺子还给你。

cards.example_en: How do you pronounce this word?
cards.example_zh: 这个词怎么发音？

cards.example_en: Wear proper shoes when you run on the track.
cards.example_zh: 在跑道上跑步时要穿合适的鞋子。

cards.example_en: Thick coats protect us from the wind at the bus stop.
cards.example_zh: 在公交车站，厚外套保护我们免受风吹。

cards.example_en: My parents are proud of me.
cards.example_zh: 我的父母为我感到骄傲。

cards.example_en: These results prove that regular sleep helps exam scores.
cards.example_zh: 这些结果证明规律睡眠有助于考试成绩。

cards.example_en: The hotel will provide breakfast for the visiting team.
cards.example_zh: 酒店将为来访的队伍提供早餐。

cards.example_en: The public library stays open until eight in the evening.
cards.example_zh: 公共图书馆开放到晚上八点。

cards.example_en: A local publisher will publish the class history book.
cards.example_zh: 一家当地出版社将出版这本班级史书。

cards.example_en: Don't pull the curtain so hard or it will tear.
cards.example_zh: 别那么用力拉窗帘，不然会扯破。

cards.example_en: The school will punish cheating.
cards.example_zh: 学校会惩罚作弊。

cards.example_en: She wore a purple scarf.
cards.example_zh: 她戴着一条紫色围巾。

cards.example_en: Seeing the pandas was the whole purpose of our visit.
cards.example_zh: 看熊猫就是我们这次参观的全部目的。

cards.example_en: You should push the door, not pull the handle.
cards.example_zh: 你应该推这扇门，而不是拉门把手。

cards.example_en: Put the milk back in the fridge after breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭后把牛奶放回冰箱。

cards.example_en: This bread is of better quality than yesterday's loaf.
cards.example_zh: 这面包的质量比昨天那条更好。

cards.example_en: A quarter of the apples were too soft to eat.
cards.example_zh: 这些苹果有四分之一软得不能吃了。

cards.example_en: The queen visited the new library.
cards.example_zh: 女王参观了新图书馆。

cards.example_en: The last question on the maths test used a bus map.
cards.example_zh: 数学试卷的最后一道问题用到了一张公交地图。

cards.example_en: That was a quick answer.
cards.example_zh: 那是一个很快的回答。

cards.example_en: Please be quiet in the library.
cards.example_zh: 请在图书馆内保持安静。

cards.example_en: It was quite cold on the morning bus.
cards.example_zh: 早上坐公交时天气相当冷。

cards.example_en: A rabbit slipped under the fence and into the garden.
cards.example_zh: 一只兔子从篱笆下面钻进了花园。

word.example_en: We prepare for the exam every evening.
word.example_zh: 我们每天晚上着手准备考试。

word.example_en: At present, she lives with her aunt.
word.example_zh: 目前她和姑姑住在一起。

word.example_en: The school will take pride in its choir.
word.example_zh: 学校会为合唱团感到自豪。

word.example_en: You will make progress if you practise.
word.example_zh: 如果练习，你就会取得进步。

word.example_en: We are proud of our school team.
He does not like to sing in public.
Put on a coat. It is cold.
We put up a notice on the board.
word.example_zh: 我们在布告栏上张贴了一则通知。

word.example_en: We may put off the picnic if it rains.
word.example_zh: 如果下雨，我们可能推迟野餐。

word.example_en: Put out the fire before you leave camp.
Put away your books before you leave.
The class starts at a quarter past eight.
